name: movie_delori_lpqi_oblateness
label: Movie: is delta Ori Aa1 oblate? H-alpha nights on the LPQI-Pathfinder against the equal-area circular disk (MPD, 40 nights)
notes: The baseline's position angle sweeps ~90 deg over the night, so an oblate disk (axis ratio 1.03 from v sin i, major axis at the assumed PA 0) departs from the circular curve in a PA-dependent way; the Fisher matrix on (theta_major, q) with the orientation fixed gives the nights to a 3 sigma detection of q - 1.
The orientation of the spin axis is unknown and the tidal distortion by the 5.73 d companion is not modelled: a first look, not a forecast.
